pages.text: Copper and zinc mixed over heat make $(l:crafting/create2#brass_ingot)brass$(/l), and brass makes the clever parts: the $(l:crafting/create2#crafting_kinetics_deployer)Deployer$(/l), the $(l:crafting/create2#crafting_kinetics_deployer)Mechanical Arm$(/l), belts and $(l:crafting/create2#crafting_kinetics_belt_connector)Depots$(/l), and sequenced assembly lines for precision work.
A Blaze Burner needs a blaze. Right-click one with an empty burner.
